Take a shelter dog out for the day in Colorado

Want to rent or borrow a dog in Colorado? These shelters let you take an adoptable dog on a day trip, hike or sleepover for free. 6 shelter programs in Colorado, 3 of them open to the public. Cities include Aspen, Denver, Divide, Durango, Grand Junction, Ridgway.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.
